body:
SKELETAL CREW MEMBER
CR 3

XP 800
CE Medium undead
Init +2, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +3 armor, +1 natural)
hp 38 (7d8 +7)
Fort +2, Ref +7, Will +5; DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune cold, undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee scimitar +8 (1d6 +2/18-20) plus siphon life

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 15, Con -, Int 2, Wis 10, Cha 13
Base Atk +5; CMB +7, CMD 19

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Thousand Cuts (Su)

When a skeletal crew member hits a target with a melee attack, it may use its attack of opportunity to immediately make another attack action against that target with a -2 penalty to its attack roll. If that attack hits, the skeletal crew member regains its attack of opportunity.

This ability may be us ed to strike multiple times, so long as it hits, but doing so stacks the -2 penalty until it either misses or the skeletal crew member chooses to stop.

Siphon Life (Su)

When a target is struck by a skeletal crew member, the target suffers 1d4 negative energy damage and the skeletal crew member is heal ed for the same a mount.
